properties.name: Lucia & Jason Armed Convenience Store Stickup & Register Grab
visual_traits: lucia wearing bandana mask holding 9mm handgun
store cashier raising trembling hands behind counter
cash drawer open with paper bills being grabbed
kicking open glass double doors into getaway muscle car

properties.name: Vice City Ocean Drive Ray-Traced Sunset & Palm Tree Cruising
spoken_exclamations: The sunset in Vice City is breathtaking!
Look at the water and palm trees!
visual_traits: luxury convertible cruising along coastal boulevard lined with royal palm trees
ray traced screen space reflections on wet asphalt and vehicle chrome
magenta and cyan neon hotel signs glowing under dusk skyline
speedboats cutting through turquoise coastal water leaving foam wake
properties.hud_trigger_rule: Ocean Drive landmark + volumetric sunset lighting + RT reflections

properties.name: 150 MPH Highway Head-On Crash & Soft-Body Panel Warping
spoken_exclamations: Oh my god look at that crumple!
150 miles per hour right into the wall!
visual_traits: high speed vehicular impact against concrete barrier or oncoming semi truck
soft body chassis accordion compression and detached bumper
radiator steam cloud burst and shattered windshield web cracks
sparks showering from metal rim dragging on asphalt
properties.hud_trigger_rule: Sudden deceleration > 50 px/frame + metallic impact peak audio (-4dB)

properties.name: Vice City Police 5-Star SWAT Armored Roadblock & Spike Strips
spoken_exclamations: They set up a full tactical roadblock!
Police helicopter spotlight is blinding me!
visual_traits: v-formation police cruiser barricade with flashing red and blue strobe lights
SWAT armored BearCat deploying tactical officers with shields
police helicopter searchlight cone tracking vehicle on bridge
spiked metal tire deflation strip laid across roadway lanes
properties.hud_trigger_rule: 5 flashing wanted stars on minimap + siren audio acoustic spike

properties.name: Leonida Everglades Swamp Airboat Drift & Alligator Encounter
spoken_exclamations: This airboat handles like a hovercraft!
Look at the mud spraying everywhere!
visual_traits: twin rudder swamp airboat drifting through dense sawgrass and mangrove marsh
viscous brown mud flinging from vehicle tires onto quarter panels
eight-foot alligator lunging off muddy riverbank into murky water
water mist and volumetric swamp fog rising under afternoon heat
properties.hud_trigger_rule: Airboat rear propeller fan + wetland water ripple optical flow

properties.name: First-Person Cockpit View with Functional Mirrors & Dashboard Gauges
spoken_exclamations: The rearview mirrors actually reflect real-time traffic!
Hands on the steering wheel shifting gears!
Look at the digital speedometer needle!
visual_traits: first person camera positioned in driver seat behind leather steering wheel
functional digital dashboard displaying illuminated speedometer and tachometer
real-time ray traced reflections visible in driver side and rearview mirrors
character hands physically turning wheel and operating paddle shifters
negative_disqualifiers: third person chase camera hovering behind bumper
properties.hud_trigger_rule: Visible steering wheel bounding box + interior windshield frame

properties.name: Stopping the Speeding Freight Train with 50 Tank Obstacles
search_queries: can you stop the train in gta 6
spoken_exclamations: Can we finally stop the train in GTA 6?!
It just plowed right through 20 cars!
Look at the sparks on the railroad tracks!
visual_traits: high speed freight locomotive hurtling down steel tracks into barricaded vehicles
metal on metal sparks spraying in continuous shower from undercarriage
chain reaction vehicular explosions and flying chassis debris
massive momentum displacement pushing obstacle line without slowing
properties.hud_trigger_rule: Train engine front grill + multiple explosion fire particles
